prompt: Aerial drone photograph of Lagos at night from high above, looking across Lagos Island and the Third Mainland Bridge toward Victoria Island and Lekki: warm city lights, the lagoon reflecting them, a clear night sky with a little deep blue left in it. Vivid but natural. The middle of the frame is calm city lights, not cluttered. Photorealistic photograph, full-frame camera, 35mm lens, natural skin tones, warm practical lighting, bright and sharp contrast, modern and well kept, aspirational but real Lagos. Vertical 9:16 composition with the subject in the middle third and calm space at the top. No text, no logos, no badges, no watermarks, no readable words on any screen or sign.
